desc: 平面推力球轴承钢质精密，可分离结构、高速静音耐负荷
name: 工业精密平面推力球轴承款

shots.intent: 用深色高反差金属质感在搜索结果里抢第一眼点击，一秒传达精密工业件定位。
shots.textZone: 顶部横向留白带供主标题，下方一枚强调色药丸标签位

shots.intent: 把四项性能主张转成一眼可读的图标矩阵，先把工艺可信度立起来。
shots.textZone: 主标题居中，四宫格图标下方各一枚短标签位

shots.intent: 把零件放回真实装机语境，让采购方一眼确认这就是他要换的那颗。
用可分离三件结构解释它为什么能扛轴向力，把卖点落到看得见的构造上。
shots.textZone: 主标题居左，三处引线标签位分列右侧

shots.intent: 用钢球与保持架微距证明材质与装配精度，替代任何口说无凭的质量话术。
滚道与端面的精磨纹理特写，让人直接看到加工痕迹而不是相信形容词。
让买家在一张图里比出规格档位，缩短选型的犹豫链路。
shots.textZone: 每个单元下方一枚尺寸占位标签位

shots.intent: 把关键尺寸一次说清，去掉下单前最硬的适配疑虑。
shots.textZone: 主标题居上，右侧三处尺寸引线标签位

shots.intent: 用可见的钢材实物与无字防护包装降低采购风险，不靠认证背书。
shots.textZone: 主标题居上，两件内容各一枚短标签位

shots.intent: 用强调色收口视觉把整套叙事收敛到一个明确的下单动作。
shots.textZone: 中上主标题位与下方按钮标签位

style.backgroundSystem: deep graphite gradient stage #14141C with a faint mirror reflection for heroes, alternating with clean off-white spec and infographic panels #EDEDEA; the same material language runs across the whole set
style.iconSystem: thin monoline #EDEDEA line icons at a single consistent stroke weight, paired with short labels; #C8102E pill chips for callouts
style.lightingSystem: cool neutral studio light around 5600K with a strong directional side and rim raking key that sculpts the polished steel, plus a soft fill on the shadow side and a real grounding contact shadow
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium industrial-hardware e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep graphite base #14141C, clean off-white panel #EDEDEA, brushed-steel neutral #B7BCC2, and one accent #C8102E; cool neutral studio lighting around 5600K; modern geometric sans-serif; thin monoline line-icon style with #C8102E pill label chips; machined polished-steel product rendered with crisp specular highlights and true circular geometry; consistent directional side and rim raking light revealing the ball set, raceways and cage; stable product scale and centering; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no brand logo, wordmark, watermark or QR code
no invented certification seals, ratings, lab numbers or origin claims
style.presentationRules: true circular ring geometry with no ellipse distortion, stable centre placement, consistent 3/4 hero angle across the set, polished steel speculars always legible, separable parts shown with logical gravity and contact shadows
style.surfaceSystem: brushed and mirror-finished machined steel, presented on matte graphite #14141C or matte off-white #EDEDEA surfaces
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; headlines and short labels in deep charcoal #2D2D2D on light panels or #EDEDEA on dark panels, set inside #C8102E pill label chips; no serif, handwritten, retro or cartoon faces
